name: pgvectorfast
abstract: High-performance drop-in enhancement for pgvector with the Calico shared buffer pool
description: pgvectorfast installs as a drop-in enhancement for pgvector on unmodified PostgreSQL 18 and 19 (Linux x86-64). It preserves SQL and on-disk compatibility for vector, halfvec, bit, and sparsevec types as well as HNSW and IVFFlat indexes, while adding the Calico array-based shared buffer pool, optimistic lock-free HNSW reads, and batched group prefetching.

calico.abstract: Calico array-based shared buffer pool extension for PostgreSQL
